notes.title: Open world update
notes.notes:
[b][h1]I decided to add open world to the game[/h1][/b]

[h2]When[/h2]
I can't give a precise date, but I can say that half of the update is ready.
It will take some time to prepare this update, so there will be no updates for a while,

[h2]Old saves[/h2]
I have set the save system to support legacy so you can continue from your old save.

[h2]Optimization[/h2]
When I compared the fps values, I saw that there is a very small difference between the new and old version, there is a slight loss of performance.

[h2]Is this the end of early access[/h2]
Yes
